title: Terraform telemetry module: opinionated Prometheus/Grafana + OTEL collector + multi-sink log shipping
creator: Ethan Chen
description: Implement a reusable Terraform module that provisions an opinionated observability stack for VPC/private deployments: Prometheus (operator or chart), Grafana (provisioned dashboards), an OpenTelemetry Collector deployment with configurable pipelines, and a log-shipping layer supporting Fluent Bit/Vector to multiple sinks (S3, ELK, Splunk). The module must: 1) expose simple variables for small/medium/large profiles with tuned resource defaults and histogram retention; 2) include lifecycle hooks and pre-/post-upgrade health probes to support safe rolling upgrades (drain hooks, read-only probe, canary rollout flag); 3) provide outputs for service endpoints, Grafana provisioning tokens, alertmanager routes, and OTEL receiver endpoints; 4) integrate with our VPC networking primitives (private subnets, security groups, egress NAT) and be usable in both hosted-dedicated and private/on-prem flows; 5) include Terraform tests (terratest or kitchen-terraform) and a documented upgrade playbook for SEs and SREs. Security constraints: collectors must support TLS mTLS to remote sinks and KMS-encrypted secrets for credentials. Module should be agnostic to Kubernetes distribution but provide opinionated Helm values for GKE/EKS/AKS and a plain k8s manifests path for air-gapped installs.
comments: 2026-01-12 - Kickoff: scoped module boundaries with infra and platform teams; agreed to ship as a single module with optional submodules (prometheus, grafana, otel, logs). Link to initial design: https://confluence.redwood-inference.com/display/OPS/VPC+Telemetry+Module

2026-01-18 - Design review (PM + Security): security requested KMS-only secret storage and mandatory TLS between collector and external sinks. Action: add 'kms_key_id' and 'tls_enabled' variables with enforced validation.

2026-01-25 - Engineering sync: decided to implement Helm provider path by default and keep raw manifests for air-gapped customers. Chose Prometheus Operator chart for easier ServiceMonitor management across tenants.

2026-02-02 - Prototype deployed in staging: tested OTLP pipeline -> long-term metrics backend; noted CPU pressure on collector with tail-based sampling enabled. Follow-up: add default 0.5 sampling and recommended CPU/memory profiles for >1k RPS.
2026-02-08 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-terraform/pull/632 (module + examples). Requesting code review from infra leads and security.
